turns.text: Hi, I need to change the delivery address. The parcel should not go to the address I used at checkout.

Hello, I can help with a delivery address change. Please send me your order number (it looks like SC-1007) and the email address you placed the order with. I also need the new address you want the parcel sent to.
The order is SC-3360, the email is nora.blake@example.com, and the new address is Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu.

Thank you, Nora. Order SC-3360 has already shipped, and our policy allows an address change only until an order ships, so I cannot change it. I have passed your request to a colleague, who will take over the chat and check whether the courier can still redirect the parcel to Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu. Please wait for their reply before you act on it.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Customer Nora Blake (verified with SC-3360 and nora.blake@example.com) asks to change the delivery address to Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu. Order has already shipped (current address on file: Str. Exemplu 8, Timisoara), so policy does not allow the change through the bot. Staff to decide whether a post-shipment address change is possible with the courier.
